2608.18704.title: MemFuse: Multi-Source Memory Fusion from Fragmented Observations
2608.18704.paper_summary: Long-term memory is essential for agents that operate across extended interactions, yet existing memory systems and benchmarks predominantly focus on single-source textual histories. In realistic settings, however, relevant information is often fragmented across applications and devices, as well as across users and time, requiring agents to integrate dispersed observations into coherent episodic memories while preserving their source provenance. To address these gaps, we introduce **MemFuseBench**, a benchmark for *multi-source memory fusion*. MemFuseBench is built with a Scene-to-Sensor pipeline that synthesizes controllable scenarios into source-tagged observations, evidence-grounded questions, and adversarial distractors. It enables systematic evaluation of temporal reasoning, cross-source evidence fusion, and robustness to noise. We further propose **MemFuse**, a structured memory system that preserves source-level evidence in event-layer atomic memory and organizes related atomic events into cluster-layer fused memory within a causal fusion graph. During retrieval, MemFuse retrieves and organizes related evidence fragments while maintaining traceability to original source events. Experiments on MemFuseBench show that MemFuse achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems under all three LLM settings and consistently improves performance on questions requiring cross-source evidence fusion.
2608.18704.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶對於在延長互動中運作的智能體至關重要，然而現有的記憶系統和基準主要集中在單一來源的文本歷史上。然而，在現實情境中，相關信息通常分散在不同的應用程序和設備之間，以及在不同的用戶和時間中，這要求智能體將分散的觀察整合成連貫的情節記憶，同時保留其來源的來源。為了解決這些空白，我們引入了 **MemFuseBench**，一個用於 *多來源記憶融合* 的基準。MemFuseBench 是基於場景到傳感器的管道構建的，該管道將可控的場景合成為帶有來源標籤的觀察、基於證據的問題和對抗性干擾項。它使得對時間推理、跨來源證據融合和對噪聲的穩健性進行系統評估成為可能。我們進一步提出了 **MemFuse**，一個結構化的記憶系統，該系統在事件層原子記憶中保留來源級別的證據，並將相關的原子事件組織成因果融合圖中的集群層融合記憶。在檢索過程中，MemFuse 檢索並組織相關的證據片段，同時保持對原始來源事件的可追溯性。在 MemFuseBench 上的實驗顯示，MemFuse 在所有三種 LLM 設定下的評估記憶系統中達到了最佳的整體性能，並且在需要跨來源證據融合的問題上持續提高了性能。
